03 / How we work

A clear path.
From hello to launch.

01 / DISCOVER

Start with your goals.

Tell us about your business, your audience and what you want to achieve. We map out the scope, priorities and right approach.

02 / CREATE

Make it take shape.

We turn the direction into designs, development or content, with feedback at agreed milestones to keep the work aligned.

03 / LAUNCH

Put it into the world.

Review the details, prepare for launch and agree on what comes next—from handover to ongoing digital support.

04 / Good questions

Before we
get started.

Do you work with clients outside Nepal?

Yes. We work with clients worldwide. Project discussions, reviews and handover can be coordinated remotely around agreed schedules.

Can I start with just one service?

Absolutely. You can start with a website, an app, an AI video or a marketing project. We can also discuss how multiple services fit together.

How much will my project cost?

Pricing depends on the scope, complexity and deliverables. Email us a brief and we’ll discuss your requirements before preparing a tailored proposal.

How long does a project take?

Timelines depend on the work involved, available content and feedback rounds. We’ll agree on a realistic schedule after understanding your brief.

What do you need from me to begin?

A short description of your business, the service you need and your main goal is enough to start. If you have a budget, deadline, brand assets or reference websites, include those too.
